entries.text: I watch the front window and keep quiet.

Sales floor. A loud metal crash came from the rear alley. Owen chose to stay put and watch everything you can see and hear. A woman takes cover at the end of the rear shelving. Mara says, "Quiet." June says, "What was that?"
You heard metal hit something hard out back. You did not see it.
Your second model is offline; turns will be thinner until it is back.
